Package view.music

Class MusicManager

java.lang.Object
view.music.MusicManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observer
public class MusicManager extends Object implements Observer
The MusicManager class is responsible for managing and playing various background music tracks in the game. It implements the Observer interface to react to changes in the game state.

    • playPlayingSong

      public void playPlayingSong()
      Plays the background music for the playing state. If the music is not already loaded, it loads the music file and starts playing it in a loop.

      public void update(Observable o, Object arg)
      Updates the sound effects based on the game state. If the player wins, it plays the winning song, otherwise it plays the losing song.
